description: Hand a site over to someone else, for example a site made for a client. They get an email with a link; when they accept, the site is theirs (pages, history, statistics, custom domains) and counts against their plan. Ask whether the person wants to stay on as an editor (keep_me_as_editor), as an agency usually does. Nothing changes until the other person accepts.

keep_me_as_editor.description:
Stay on as an editor after the handover (an agency looking after a client's site). Ask the person;
default false, which means they lose access once it is accepted.

to_email.description: The email address of the person who takes the site over.

name: transfer_site
